files.desc: Game exe with all code changes, including the Client Tweaks window (ESC > Settings > System > Client Tweaks) where each fix can be switched on or off: borderless window, Night/Day only, FPS + Ping (every 3 s), health bars, bar numbers, Player Kills counter, chat keeps focus when you get hit, bigger world map (right-click = Back, opens zoomed out), short logo screen, skip server list, centred Action camera, Locked Target, Forced Move blocked, Tab ignore fix, mail Get All, Max Zoom, Zoom Speed, Display Mode, Compatibility mode, Minimal Mode fog, bag fix and search, stash and marketplace search, EXP warnings, boss tooltips, custom Minimal Mode (draw distances, grass / far terrain / ground paint, background FPS limit, players drawn, players without costumes, effect distance), the Celestial Reforge auto-reforge tool, and skills facing the camera while you hold the right mouse button. The windows and buttons come from the interface files below. New in v12: higher in-world FPS cap and background-window FPS limit (Client Tweaks > Performance), Mirage Cavern minimap arrows that walk you through each doorway (Client Tweaks > Mirage Cavern), General Power target mode per skill key, Alt + right-click opens a whole stack, loot auto-roll and System mail auto-claim (Quick Settings), FPS / ping and a Quick Settings cogwheel in the top bar, and the game-side parts of the Gem Cleanser, Multi Disassembly and Gem Auto-Combine tools. Also fixes the random crash after leaving an instance / changing map (two loading threads rebuilding the same shader at once).
Turns off the debug console.
Forced Move needs more stamina than anyone has, so it can't be used.
Loading screen at game start shows only the Swordsman logo (no Perfect World logo, no book).
Self-Cultivation Settings > Healing: new row 'World Energy below [0-200] auto-use item' in Rest Settings (uses a World Energy Remedy or Fresh Dragonspit Herb from your bag).
Bigger chat box by default (450x300); you can still resize it.
The Client Tweaks window: on/off switches for every client fix, including the new Performance (FPS cap, background FPS) and Mirage Cavern sections.
Multi-EXP window: usable in combat, shows World Energy use per minute and time left.
Warning before an EXP item with a different multiplier replaces your remaining EXP time.
Hides the target info popup in the middle of the screen.
0-100 numbers under the Stamina, Rage and Warsoul bars (works with the game exe).

Game window list: adds the Player Kills counter and the new Client Tweaks, search, EXP warning, Minimal Settings, Reforge tool, Quick Settings, Gem Cleanser, Multi Disassembly and Gem Auto-Combine windows.
Text fix: the chat cooldown message now names the Alliance Channel instead of Dragon's Roar.
Multi Disassembly, docks left of the Disassemble page: tick gear and it disassembles it piece by piece with your Disassembly Charms.
Gem Cleanser helper, docks left of the Gem Cleansing page: plans which gems to cleanse with your crystal income and does the next step with the game's own buttons.
Gem Auto-Combine, docks left of the Gem Combination page: tick gems and it combines them with your Gem Combination Charms (optionally keeps combining what it makes).
Bag: Material / Quest / Gift tabs, Lock / Unlock / Booth / Equip buttons, coin and note display, search magnifier.
Bag 1 window layout for the bag fix.
Bag 2 window layout for the bag fix.
Big bag: Bag / Bag 1 / Bag 2 / All views, pages, Sort Selected / Sort All, free-slot counter.
The Player Kills counter above your character portrait. Install together with gameui.dcf (works with the game exe).
Adds the Get All button to the mailbox (works with the game exe).
Hides the Chinese Minimal Mode banner; wider top bar so the FPS / ping text and the Quick Settings cogwheel fit.
Top bar (map name row): FPS / ping text and the Quick Settings cogwheel next to the area icons.

The Minimal Settings window (ESC > Settings > System > Minimal Settings): draw distances, grass / far terrain / ground paint, presets, background FPS limit, players drawn, players without costumes, effect distance.
Minimap without the old FPS + Ping line (it moved to the top bar, next to the map name).
Wider recipe list in every crafting window so long item names fit. Install together with the crafting background (surfaces).
Bag search bar (item name or item ID).
Marketplace search bar. It never buys anything.
Stash search bar.
Sycee Marketplace (J): search box.
The Celestial Reforge auto-reforge window, opens on the left of the Reforge window: tick the stats / skills you want and it reforges until it gets them. New: "Pay with Notes first, then Coins".
Settings > Control Scheme redone: "Set per key" with padlocks under keys 1-8 (Locked Target / Area Select per key for General Power).
Reorganized Settings > Gameplay tab, incl. the Show Players Health Bar checkbox (works with the game exe).
Settings > Key Bind list view: clearer column and button names.
Settings > Key Bind keyboard view: smaller key text so action names don't overlap.
Redesigned Settings > System tab with Display Mode, Max Zoom, Zoom Speed, Compatibility mode, Night/Day only, and the Client Tweaks and Minimal Settings buttons at the bottom. Needs the game exe.
Personal stash: search magnifier.
Quick Settings panel: name labels (names only, other guilds in red), Player kill counter, loot auto-roll, System mail auto-claim.
Smaller map name labels on the world map.
Hides the Chinese Minimal Mode banner; wider top bar (second interface archive).
Lets you zoom the camera out further on every map.
Logic for the Client Tweaks window (choices saved in userdata\ClientTweaks.ini).
Logic for the EXP replacement warning.

Registers the new windows and runs the World Energy auto-use, Minimal Settings, the Celestial Reforge tool, General Power per-key target mode, Quick Settings (name labels, kill counter, loot auto-roll, System mail auto-claim), Alt + right-click stack opening, Gem Cleanser, Multi Disassembly, Gem Auto-Combine and the Mirage arrow step.
Multi Disassembly window script.
Gem Cleanser window script.
Gem Auto-Combine window script.
Top bar script: the cogwheel opens Quick Settings.
Logic for the Minimal Settings window (saved in userdata\MinimalMode.ini).
Logic for the bag search.
Logic for the marketplace search.
Logic for the stash search.
Logic for the Celestial Reforge auto-reforge window.
Opens the Client Tweaks and Minimal Settings windows from Settings > System.
Quick Settings panel script.
Rare Animal Island boss tooltips (direction, spawn coordinates, trophy) and Jade Sung boss names.
Background of the FPS / ping text in the top bar.
Greyed-out small button on the Control Scheme page.
Background of the redone Settings > Control Scheme page.
Greyed-out padlock for the per-key target mode on the Control Scheme page.
